reviews.title: Good Quality for the price!
reviews.comment: This is very nice! I have a $600 Sennheiser microphone, but this sounded like my expensive wireless Sennheiser. It’s worth for the price. Very good quality to use for practice or home karaoke.
reviews.author: A.C.C

reviews.title: Pretty good for an inexpensive Sennheiser mic...
reviews.comment: It's a good mic for the price... I have an e835 that I love but it doesn't have a on/off switch and the one that does is a little out of my price range at the moment so I ordered this one on a whim... It's not as deep sounding but it's very clear and it seems pretty durable...
reviews.author: Cecil Pena

reviews.title: Good quality
reviews.comment: Pleased so far. Sound quality is good and no hiss or hum. Seem very sturdy and love the on/off function.
reviews.author: Anthony M

reviews.title: Sennheiser is an industry standard.
reviews.comment: Very reliable vocal mic. I would compare it to the SM58, but a lot more affordable.
reviews.author: Kolin Lawler

reviews.title: Good value for money
reviews.comment: Works just great for my trivia nights. feels pretty indestructible, which is the kind of quality I was looking for and expected from Sennheiser. The sound is clear, and directional.
reviews.author: Jim. D
